_comment: "Target sword attack gets 'When this hits, SHARPEN this sword. Then if the sword has 3 or more +1{p} counters, ATTACK with it'." BOTH clauses are inside the on-hit; the JSON sharpened immediately on resolution instead. The counter was PUT_COUNTER of a kind literally named "SHARPEN", which is not the kind SHARPEN uses ("power", the kind _recalculate_attack_power already adds), so the 3-counter gate could never see it either.
